settings.heading: What stays out of the pot

settings.title: A banned list
settings.text: Parabens, phthalates, sulfates, PEGs, EDTA and BPA never make it into a formula.

settings.title: Watching the rules
settings.text: We track new regulations and restrictions, and update the list as they change.

settings.title: Honest labels
settings.text: Vegan, cruelty-free, gluten-free and made in the US, Canada or Germany, stated plainly.

settings.quote: “I wanted fewer products that each worked harder, on every face I met.”

settings.note: For years I carried two bags: clean products that did not perform, and performers I did not trust. So I made the formulas I wanted for my own kit, one multi-use cream at a time.
